title: The Signature Vision: Treehouse City Districts
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Treehouse City Districts.
description:

Signature district hulls program, charter one: master tree platforms at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale district logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate arborist care systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Treehouse City Districts becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: 2030 — First district hulls districts certified: tree platforms assembl
definition: 2030 milestone on the Treehouse City Districts roadmap.
description:
First district hulls districts certified: tree platforms assembly at half the time and carbon of legacy builds.

What must be true first: the tree platforms results have to replicate outside the lab, district logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and arborist care operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed tree platforms demonstrations, district logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting arborist care uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

definition: Estimates Treehouse City Districts readiness from component maturity.

Honest scoring is the point: a district hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Treehouse City Districts Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Treehouse City Districts operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Treehouse City Districts installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 52672 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where tree platforms monitoring, district logistics redundancy, or arborist care maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Treehouse City Districts Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Treehouse City Districts: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Treehouse City Districts — districts of permanent treehouses.

Phase 1 — Prove (tree platforms): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (district logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (arborist care): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (access design): district hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and forests-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
